body: The Long Beach Community Investment Company - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 10, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Alejandra Ramirez, Chair  Richard Lewis, Director
Eva Melgarejo, Vice Chair  Ruben Minjarez, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Elwood Sides, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Meggan.Sorensen@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55412  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55413  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting of Wednesday, March 18, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55416  Recommendation to conduct the second public hearing on the preparation of the
  Fiscal Year (FY) 2026-2027 Action Plan and Substantial Amendments to the FY
  2019-2020, FY 2020-2021, FY 2021-2022, FY 2022-2023 and FY 2025-2026
  Action Plans for the expenditure of CDBG, HOME and ESG funds; accept public
  comment and recommend City Council approval. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55417  Recommendation to adopt The Long Beach Community Investment Company
  proposed Fiscal Year 2026-2027 (FY 27) budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55415  Recommendation to approve the selection of Jamboree Housing Corporation
  (Jamboree) for an award of Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions

  Authorize President or designee to enter into an Agreement to Negotiate

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55414  Recommendation to approve the selection of Century Affordable Development,
  Inc. (CADI) for an award of Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions
  Agency (LACAHSA) and/or HOME funds in the amount of up to $5,000,000; and

  Authorize President or designee to enter into an Agreement to Negotiate
  Exclusively with CADI for new construction of affordable rental housing units.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address The Long Beach Community Investment Company on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-3807 or (562) 570-6957.
